title: Wrapping holes must not be charged twice
statement: The producer identifies a defect in a naive cyclic hole scan and replaces it with full-intersection peeling, removing all of a selected projection from the remaining cyclic interval. This prevents reuse of a wrapping hole. Raising the contractible cutoff to4R2/3 requires new kernel/pressure bounds and a separately paid marked-large-hole tail, using the global field cap once. These are interfaces for the sector theorem, not automatic extensions of old small-hole activities or an inferred negligible complementary class.
